channel.title: Daily Recap — 🏎️ F1
channel.description: What happened in 🏎️ F1, recapped daily from subscribed feeds.

item.title: Verstappen wins chaotic wet Singapore sprint, then storms to pole after rain-delayed qualifying
item.description:
Max Verstappen won a rain-hit Singapore sprint — the first ever at Marina Bay — then overcame a Ferrari challenge to take pole after qualifying was delayed by weather. He warned of a massive qualifying battle and admitted that with Red Bull's horrendous starts, 'Sunday's race is over' if they don't fix them. Full starting grid and qualifying head-to-heads are published.

Sources:

  • F1 Singapore GP: Max Verstappen wins sprint, George Russell crashes out and McLarens collide
  • F1 Singapore GP: Max Verstappen overcomes Ferrari challenge for pole
  • Starting grid for the 2026 F1 Singapore GP
  • FIA reveals new start time for delayed F1 qualifying at Singapore GP

item.title: McLaren civil war: Norris and Piastri collide on the sprint's final lap
item.description:
Lando Norris and Oscar Piastri collided on the final lap of the Singapore sprint, prompting team principal Andrea Stella to call it 'simply not acceptable.' Piastri called the clash embarrassing, Norris was summoned by the stewards, and the team faces a tense debrief before Sunday's race.

Sources:

  • Andrea Stella: Singapore F1 sprint collision between Lando Norris and Oscar Piastri "simply not acceptable"
  • Oscar Piastri speaks out after McLaren's final-lap F1 crash
  • Singapore GP stewards reveal Lando Norris investigation decision following Oscar Piastri clash

item.title: Russell crashes out of the sprint lead: 'a very bad day because of my own mistake'
item.description:
George Russell crashed out while leading the wet Singapore sprint, later owning it as 'a very bad day because of my own mistake.'

Sources:

  • George Russell crashes out of lead at wet Singapore F1 sprint
  • George Russell: 'A very bad day because of my own mistake'

item.title: Mercedes baffled by failed upgrades as Hamilton blames a setup gamble
item.description:
Mercedes' tricky Singapore upgrade isn't delivering — Toto Wolff admits the team is baffled, and analysis shows how it's been working (or not) at Marina Bay. Lewis Hamilton took the blame for pushing a setup change too far in qualifying, leaving the two Mercedes drivers bitterly divided after the session.

  • How Mercedes' tricky F1 upgrade has been working at Singapore GP
  • Mercedes boss admits team is baffled by failed 2026 F1 upgrades
  • How Hamilton "tipped it over the edge" with a setup change too far in Singapore GP qualifying
  • Mercedes drivers speak out after bitterly divided F1 qualifying session in Singapore

item.title: Hamilton celebrates African GP breakthrough — and calls for Singapore track changes
item.description:
Lewis Hamilton celebrated a breakthrough in his push for an African Grand Prix as F1 secured a shock return venue. He also called for changes to the Marina Bay circuit, saying it would have been 'the most boring race without rain.'

Sources:

  • Lewis Hamilton celebrates breakthrough in push for African Grand Prix
  • Lewis Hamilton calls for Singapore track changes: "Would have been the most boring race without rain"

item.title: Verstappen hints at changes after poor starts; Hadjar demands major Red Bull engine fixes
item.description:
Max Verstappen hinted at changes after Red Bull's poor starts in Malaysia and Singapore, while Isack Hadjar demanded massive engine changes, saying 'everything is breaking apart.'
